instruction: A candid documentary photograph with a shallow depth of field, captured in a full shot at eye-level. On an outdoor wooden boardwalk with a metal railing, four friends are playfully dancing in a line. On the far left, the man in the orange t-shirt (R2) steps forward in black shorts and grey sneakers, smiling. Next to him, the woman in the beige hoodie (R1) steps forward in grey leggings and pink sneakers, looking down with a smile. The woman in the grey hijab (R3) steps forward in a pink jacket, white pants, and pink sneakers, also looking down. On the far right, the man in the grey t-shirt (R4) steps forward in grey sweatpants and grey sneakers, looking down at his feet. Soft, natural daylight with a warm tone highlights their expressions.
